rationale.org-governance: Capability-risk-control register structures centralized organizational governance and recurring audits.
rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Vets LLMs, MCP servers, tools, and interfaces against compromise.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Requires persistent logs and decision traces for review and post-incident audit.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Defines approval, confirmation, takeover, and interrupt controls for high-impact actions.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Monitoring and traces expose agent actions, choices, and outcomes to operators.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Alerts detect behavioral drift; thresholds bound agents' permitted action scope.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Prescribes linters, static analysis, CVE scans, schemas, and sandboxes.
rationale.metrics: Defines security risk through impact, likelihood, and relevance thresholds.
